29485925.source: AACT 2026-08-30 structured 30-day in-hospital mortality, summed across SMART's two ClinicalTrials.gov registrations (medical NCT02444988: balanced 418/2735, saline 467/2646; other NCT02547779: balanced 400/5207, saline 408/5214) = balanced 818/7942, saline 875/7860. VERIFIED against the published SMART report (PMID 29485925): 818/7942=10.3% and 875/7860=11.1% match the abstract's stated 30-day in-hospital mortality (10.3% vs 11.1%) and denominators (7942 vs 7860). The abstract states only percentages, so the primary report does not carry the counts; these exact counts are the structured registry data.
